paper_title: Hunting Dark Matter Lines in the Infrared Background with the James Webb Space Telescope
notes: Continuum-model 2sigma power-constrained limits on ALP-photon coupling from JWST NIRSpec blank sky observations. Only two explicit numerical (mass, coupling) points quoted in text: g_agamma > 2.4e-11 GeV^-1 at m_a=1 eV and g_agamma > 9.4e-12 GeV^-1 at m_a=2.15 eV. Full curve spans ~0.8-3 eV but only these points are numerically stated. DM density: NFW with rho_s=0.18 GeV/cm^3 (not local density directly; rho_s used). Also constrains decay lifetime tau; ALP coupling is the physics-coupling result.
